verdict.rationale: Supabase docs mention 'several ways to connect to your Postgres database' (supabase-docs-20) and Read Replicas for load balancing, but there is no evidence of a built-in connection pooler (e.g., Supavisor/pgbouncer replacement) handling thousands of concurrent connections without operating a separate proxy — this specific capability is never described in the pack. Missing for 10: any mention of a pooling product/feature, pooler architecture, concurrent-connection benchmarks, or documentation replacing the need for pgbouncer.
